items.html: However, the matter is that all the aspects that ZA has in those seven kings were clarified — from Keter to Netzah; but his aspects of Hod, Yesod, and Malchut, which are mixed there in those seven kings, were not all clarified, as is known. For the seven kings include from the ZON of Atzilut until the end of the world of Assiya. And remember this rule, as was said in this chapter regarding the matter of the blood of birth.
